# C# Analyzer - (current)

> Explore how the C# Analyzer helps translate MongoDB .NET/C# Driver code into the MongoDB Query API and checks for unsupported expressions.

- [Analyze POCOs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-analyzer/current/code-type/pocos.md)
